novel_mechanics_found: Level 5's previously missing second color-8 gravity switch was located at the bottom-right of the trap-pair screen. It becomes visible as soon as the player moves left once after the deep remote-door descent (screen center approximately x=51,y=59), and after the camera drops it is at approximately x=51,y=53. Clicking it from either door-aligned column (player near x=22 or x=27) causes immediate death, consistent with the gravity reversal carrying the player into a pillar; the likely safe timing is one movement earlier while the player is still near x=33 and the switch is already visible. The deep descent also requires opening a remote E door and then moving laterally into its column; opened one-cell E pockets can be traversed sideways even though they appear soft-locked.
narrative: The 121-action registry prefix was replayed successfully from fresh resets and confirmed frame.levels_completed == 4 before exploration. Level 5 was explored through the known right-door chain, then extended beyond the previously logged wall: a remote lower E door plus a lateral move reaches the deep trap-pair band, and moving left reveals the missing second gravity switch. Two live attempts clicked that switch after dropping into pillar-aligned columns and both died immediately; the final trace established that the switch is already visible one action earlier while the player is at the apparently safe x≈33 column, but the death consumed the live session and only 43 of 700 calls remained, fewer than the 121 needed to restore the prefix. No additional level was won. The explicit reproduce() gate was not run, so reproduction_verified is conservatively false even though the starting prefix replayed successfully multiple times.
gotchas: env.reset() returns to the start of the whole game, not the start of level 5; each new exploration life costs the full 121-action prefix.
ACTION7 is a no-op during normal play and does not restart the level after GAME_OVER; after GAME_OVER it returned an empty level-0 frame.
A same-environment reset-and-prefix replay diverged once and ended at level 0, while genuinely fresh environments replayed the prefix correctly; use a fresh env/scorecard for reliable restoration.

The second gravity switch is visible before the final leftward drop: after the deep descent, one left move shows it near (51,59), and after the camera shift it appears near (51,53). Flip it while still in the safe x≈33 column; waiting until x≈27 or x≈22 is lethal.

The E-door descent is not simply click-the-door-underfoot: opening a remote lower door and then taking a lateral move can trigger a long fall. Camera-relative click coordinates must be reread after every fall.
The 121-action action_sequence in this artifact is only the banked fresh-reset prefix reaching level 4; failed level-5 exploratory suffixes are intentionally excluded.
